title: Yeni Uncharted oyunu geliştirme aşamasında olabilir
summary: Kotaku ve IGN'in aktardığı bilgilere göre, Naughty Dog stüdyosu yeni bir Uncharted oyunu üzerinde çalışıyor.
body:
Kotaku ve IGN'in aktardığı bilgilere göre, Naughty Dog yeni bir **Uncharted** oyunu geliştiriyor. MP1st adlı kaynağın haberine ve sektörden NateTheHate'in açıklamalarına dayandırılan iddialara göre, hazırlık aşamasındaki bu yapım bir yeniden yapım olmayacak ve seriye tamamen yeni bir halka ekleyecek.

## Projenin başında kim var?

Stüdyonun kıdemli isimlerinden **Shaun Escayag** projeyi yöneten isim olarak öne çıkıyor. Escayag daha önce Uncharted: The Lost Legacy projesinde de liderlik yapmıştı. Serinin efsanevi karakteri Nathan Drake'in de projede yer alacağı belirtiliyor, ancak ana karakter mi olacağı yoksa yan birrolde mi görüneceği henüz netlik kazanmış değil.

## Ne zaman çıkacak?

Oyunun henüz erken geliştirme aşamasında olduğu ve stüdyonun sıradaki oyunu olan Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet'ın tamamlanmasının ardından beklendiği ifade ediliyor. Stüdyo, Intergalactic için 2027 yılında kapsamlı bir tanıtım yapacağını duyururken, yeni Uncharted oyununun PlayStation 6 döneminin ilk yarısında oyuncularla buluşabileceği tahmin ediliyor.

**Neden önemli?** Serinin hayranları uzun süredir Nathan Drake'in maceralarının devam edip etmeyeceğini merak ediyordu. Yapılan son raporlar ve stüdyo içinden gelen ipuçları, popüler macera serisinin yeni bir oyunla geri döneceğine işaret ediyor.
editor_note: Haber, IGN ve Kotaku'nun aktardığı sektör raporlarına dayanmaktadır; resmi duyuru beklenmektedir.

source_texts.title: Naughty Dog Reportedly Working On A New Uncharted Game
source_texts.text:
Fans have speculated for years about whether Uncharted 5 will ever happen. According to a new report by MP1st, Naughty Dog is indeed planning to return to its hit artifact-hunting adventure series as soon as it’s finished with Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet.
The upcoming Uncharted game reportedly won’t be a remake but a new entry in the series. Naughty Dog veteran Shaun Escayag, who returned to the studio in 2021 after working on Marvel’s Avengers at Crystal Dynamics, is apparently leading the project. Series protagonist Nathan Drake will also reportedly return, though it’s unclear in what capacity. Plus it sounds early enough in the concept phase that everything could still be subject to change.
Lending additional credence to the report is mystery industry leaker NateTheHate. Yesterday he posted that Escayag wasn’t working on any of the Last of Us projects recently teased by the studio, and today he confirmed that he understood him to be working on a new Uncharted game.
Add to all of this the fact that Escayag previously posted a picture of an old canon at Fort George in Trinidad and Tobago on his Instagram earlier this year and you have a very convincing case for the return of Uncharted in the near future. Though given the pace at which Naughty Dog hasn’t been releasing games during the PlayStation 5 console generation, who knows when we’ll ever see it.
The studio promised a full reveal of Intergalactic: The Heretic ProphetÂ in 2027. The best fans might hope for is a new Uncharted game at some point in the first half of the PS6 lifecycle.

source_texts.title: New Uncharted Game Featuring Nathan Drake Reportedly in the Works at Naughty Dog
source_texts.summary: A new report claims that a brand new Uncharted game featuring Nathan Drake is one of several projects in the works at Naughty Dog.
source_texts.text:
A new report claims that a brand new Uncharted game featuring Nathan Drake is one of several projects in the works at Naughty Dog.
MP1st has reported that the next Uncharted game, which is not a remake of any kind, is in active development at Naughty Dog. The game will feature Nathan Drake in some capacity, but it's unclear if he's the lead, in a supporting role, or even just a cameo. The project is being helmed by Shaun Escayag, who previously led Uncharted: The Lost Legacy, a standalone expansion for Uncharted 4. This has been heavily speculated for years now, with Escayag having recently teased the project himself on his socials.
The director was in Trindad earlier this year for "research" and posted a picture of a very old-looking cannon. MP1st noted that the new Uncharted game is set to be Naughty Dog's next game following the release of Intergalactic, which is speculated to launch next year. The studio recently confirmed that it will give a proper look at its upcoming sci-fi game in 2027, as well.
Additionally, Naughty Dog confirmed it has multiple Last of Us projects in the works beyond the existing HBO TV series. Series creator Neil Druckmann has avoided revealing what mediums these projects will utilize, so they could be shows, films, books, or games. However, it feels like a safe bet that at least one of them is probably a video game, and fans are hoping it's The Last of Us Part 3.
The next Uncharted game is expected to be at least a couple of years away. Uncharted 4 was released a decade ago and put a nice bow on Nathan Drake's adventures. However, given that he remained alive and well, the door has always been left open for another escapade. Now, Drake could be joined by his daughter, Cassie, who takes a clear interest in Nathan's same hobbies.
